diagnosis.cause: The source package's campaign split loader checked source file size and mtime_ns because WNN_PORTABLE_DATA_MANIFEST was absent from child step environments. Kaggle mounted the pinned chain_folds asset at a different mtime, so both fit jobs failed the split-source check before training.
evidence: The smoke3 phase log records fold0 assets mounted and both GPU workers started before each fit failed in load_campaign_split.
The fold0 split manifest expects cache/chain_folds.npz SHA-256 a2cfe843a7ce3085d383524a9d1438154fba4f2e0af6df48ee1e1b015e5c942f; the local reviewed source file matches that hash.

The source archive contains no cache/chain_folds.npz; the mounted fold0 assets expose the corresponding hash-named file and portable registry research/campaign_2026-10-04/portable_inputs.json (SHA-256 90d26c7063050092eeda774c7c6298897a8fb133e4804ac13d0a281bd328ff8c).
Prior E520 terminal diagnosis records the same missing WNN_PORTABLE_DATA_MANIFEST environment handoff and prescribes passing the verified portable registry to the campaign split loader.
diagnosis.classification: execution/package integration failure; no scientific fit or score evidence
diagnosis.corrective_action: Build a new identified smoke successor that verifies the mounted portable registry against its reviewed hash and sets WNN_PORTABLE_DATA_MANIFEST for fit and prediction children; keep smoke3 frozen.
